fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-05-20, the complainant was allegedly surrounded and attacked by several persons near Sindhu Garden Residential Colony in Erode after a dispute over a boundary issue. The time of the incident was given as 01:45 on 2025-05-19. Sathish Kumar submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000268. The complaint refers to Vasanth Mani, a neighbour, reachable on 9000000382. The complainant noted the registration number TN-33-ZZ-1029 of a yellow van. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Jagan Raman, using the number 9000000369. Madhan Palanisamy (9000000295) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Items referenced in the complaint: a witness statement and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Several persons reportedly attacked the victim in a secluded stretch. A van was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: group assault, injury, suspect, witness statement, photograph, witness, night, residential colony
